issue.title: Provide local XCTest execution for bob-mac-capture agents
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1rq.4.1.4 note 2 and corroborated during sase-1rq.4.1 landing. bob-mac-capture AGENTS.md explicitly records that the tailnet mac has only Command Line Tools and no XCTest; Scripts/typecheck-tests.sh lines 40-58 probes XCTest and otherwise compiles against Scripts/typecheck/XCTest.swift, which is a typecheck-only stub. The approved epic plan documented twelve tests that had never passed CI despite local typechecking. Decide with Bryan whether to install full Xcode on the existing mac or offer another agent-accessible macOS/Xcode host, then provide a documented scratch-checkout command that executes the AppKit XCTest targets. Keep portable-check on Linux and the existing unfiltered macOS CI gate. Acceptance: an agent can run the affected tests locally, see a deliberately failing assertion fail, and run the restored tests successfully. Large because provisioning, installation approval, host choice, and execution workflow need planning; no install authorized by this bead itself.

task_type_fields.proposal: Provide an agent-accessible macOS host with real XCTest and a documented local execution workflow for bob-mac-capture.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The epic repairs existing failing tests and proves master CI green. Host/toolchain provisioning predates the epic, requires a separate owner decision, and is not required for the completed CI fix.

issue.creation_reason: Follow-up proposed by sase-1rq.4.1.4 note 2: agents currently discover runtime XCTest failures only in remote CI. This infrastructure gap predates the repaired epic and needs its own host/toolchain decision.
